data.one_liner: A widget that makes any static located widget hidable on scroll.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Hidable widget that bridges a scroll controller with widgets like AppBars or BottomNavigationBars to hide or show them automatically as the user scrolls. Supports optional opacity animation, custom delta factors, and custom visibility algorithms.
use_when: You want to hide a BottomNavigationBar or AppBar when the user scrolls down
You want to maximize screen space for scrollable content on demand
avoid_when: You are not using a scroll controller that can be shared between the scrollable and the hidable widget
strengths: Easy to integrate with existing ScrollControllers
Supports customizable hiding/appearing speed and opacity animations
weaknesses: Requires sharing the same ScrollController between the scrollable view and the hidable widget
